content: सारूप्यम् .²1 Sameness of form, similarity, likeness, conformity, resemblance; अन्तर्वृत्तिसारूप्यतः <ls>Māl. 5</ls>. .²2 Assimilation to the deity (one of the four states of {%Mukti%}). .²3 (In dramas) An angry treatment of one mistaken for another through resemblance; सारूप्यमभिभूतस्य सारूप्यात् क्षोभवर्तनम् <ls>S. D. 464</ls>. .²4 Surprise at seeing an object or its likeness seen elsewhere. --{%a.%} Fit, proper, suitable.
